Marsiva MR-UF1200 1200VA Smart Line-Interactive UPS

The Marsiva MR-UF1200 1200VA Smart Line-Interactive UPS delivers powerful and reliable backup protection for your home or office electronics. With a capacity of 1200VA / 720W, it safeguards PCs, networking equipment, and sensitive devices from power outages, voltage fluctuations, and surges. Featuring Smart Line-Interactive technology with Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR), it stabilizes input power without switching to battery, extending battery life and performance.


Equipped with a high-performance 12V/7Ah battery, the MR-UF1200 provides extended runtime and fast recharge capabilities. It includes LED indicators, an audible alarm, and overload and short-circuit protection, making it a dependable power management solution for small offices, home setups, and business-critical systems.


Key Features:

  • 1200VA / 720W power capacity
  • Smart Line-Interactive UPS with AVR
  • 12V/7Ah  high-capacity battery
  • Simulated sine wave output – safe for most electronics
  • Fast recharge and long backup time
  • Overload, surge, and short circuit protection
  • LED status indicators and audible alerts
  • Ideal for computers, routers, CCTV, and office equipment
